browser_import.title: How to export account JSON from Chrome (install extension once)
browser_import.unzip: , extract it and keep the folder in a permanent location.
browser_import.load: , enable Developer mode, select Load unpacked and choose the extracted notion-manager-extension folder.
browser_import.use: Read workspaces in the extension, select a verified Business workspace by ID, and download account JSON to import here. Trials and other plans are rejected; the server independently verifies billing.
browser_import.privacy: The extension reads the current identity only after a click. Exported JSON contains login credentials: do not share it. Your dashboard password is not needed by the extension.
browser_import.refresh: The pool updates after import; importing the same identity updates its session. You can also paste token_v2 or the extension's full JSON below.
browser_import.invalid_json: Invalid account JSON: token_v2 must be nonempty; user_id and space_id, if supplied, must be nonempty strings.
browser_import.file_too_large: Account JSON must not exceed 1 MB.
browser_import.file_privacy: Files go only to the local account pool. Identity and workspace are verified during import.
browser_import.auto_workspace: No workspace ID supplied; accounts with multiple workspaces must select one in the extension first

models.address_note: Use Base URL in clients and the full endpoint for direct requests. OpenAI Base URLs already include /v1; do not append it twice.
models.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select the value to copy it manually and check browser clipboard permission.
models.auth_note: Use the API key shown on this session-protected page. OpenAI: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>. Anthropic: x-api-key: <API_KEY> and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01.
models.source_note: From the session-protected public model catalog, matching /v1/models. Availability still depends on account permissions, quota and upstream status.
models.empty: No models found. Add an available account and refresh quota.

ai_usage.title: Notion AI plan usage
ai_usage.unavailable: Plan usage unavailable. Refresh quota to retry.
ai_usage.note: Rolling/monthly plan usage is measured separately from compatibility Basic/Premium metrics. Values reflect the last successful check.

auth.prompt: Enter admin key to access Dashboard

account.no_workspace_alert: This account has no accessible Notion workspace and cannot open /ai proxy. Please re-register or select another account.
account.no_workspace_tooltip: No accessible workspace, excluded from selection pool

add.title: Add Notion Account
add.subtitle: Only verified Business Plan subscriptions are accepted (not trials). Same-name workspaces are distinguished by ID.
add.how_to: Manual: Open signed-in app.notion.com (or notion.so) → Developer tools → Application → Cookies → Copy token_v2.
add.placeholder: Paste token_v2 or account config JSON…

register.title: Bulk Register Accounts
register.credentials_placeholder:
One account per line, separated by four hyphens:
email----password----client_id----refresh_token

example@hotmail.com----P@ssw0rd----abcd-1234----0.AYI...
register.proxy_desc_fallback_global: Supports socks5 / socks5h / http / https. Proxy entered here takes precedence; leave blank to fallback to global proxy (enabled).
register.proxy_desc_fallback_direct: Supports socks5 / socks5h / http / https. Proxy entered here takes precedence; leave blank for direct connection (no global proxy configured).
register.modal_close_note: Closing the modal will not cancel submitted tasks. You can view them in "History Tasks".
register.paste_credentials_warning: Please paste at least one line of credentials
register.proxy_url_invalid: Proxy URL must start with http:// or socks5:// etc.

history.title: History Tasks
history.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this task? This action cannot be undone, and credential backups will be cleared.

upgrade.coverage: Captured since {{since}} · Retained from {{retained}} · Retention {{days}} days
upgrade.incomplete: Collection is incomplete or storage is {{status}}; metrics cover recorded data only.
upgrade.filter_note: Blank time fields use the last 24 hours. Search covers metadata only; conversation content is not stored.
upgrade.invalid_time: Enter valid dates with the start before the end.
upgrade.metrics_note: Success rate uses finalized requests; latency uses successful requests. Unknown token usage is shown as —.
upgrade.account_metrics_note: Requests are deduplicated within each account. Success / failure / cancellation count attempts. One request may involve several workspaces; account rows cannot be summed as global requests.
upgrade.pool_summary: Members {{total}} · Available {{available}} · Paused {{paused}} · Exhausted {{exhausted}} · Cooling {{cooldown}} · Invalid {{invalid}} · Busy {{busy}}
upgrade.history_note: Existing token totals remain separate and do not reconstruct request logs or success rates.
upgrade.saved: Saved and verified against the effective configuration.
upgrade.invalid_number: Use non-negative integers; retention must be 1–3650 days.
upgrade.ask_note: ASK answers without editing pages; the -ask model suffix also enables it per request.
upgrade.pool_note: Every enabled and available member participates equally. Existing sessions reuse a valid bound account. The pool has no fixed member limit.
upgrade.budget_note: An attempt budget of 0 uses the current candidate pool size. Concurrency 0 means unlimited. A request never retries the same account.
upgrade.retention_note: Only expired request records in the new log store are pruned. Accounts, old debug logs and historical token totals are kept. Shortening retention removes expired request records.
upgrade.business_only: Only verified, non-trial Business workspaces can be imported. Chrome one-click and JSON / token imports remain available. Free registration and automatic replenishment are unavailable.
upgrade.reason_manually_paused: Manually paused; quota recovery will not enable it
upgrade.reason_invalid_credentials: Authentication failed. Import this account’s current credentials again. Quotas below retain their last recorded values; authentication failure does not zero them.
upgrade.coverage_incomplete: The selected window extends beyond collected or retained data. Metrics cover recorded data only.
upgrade.storage_warning: Request log storage is {{status}}; metrics may be incomplete.
upgrade.chart_legend: Green: success · Red: failure / rejection / interruption · Yellow: cancellation · Blue: in progress
upgrade.invalid_connection: The API key endpoint returned an invalid response.

quota.known_premium_summary: Known compatibility Premium balance {{balance}} · Unknown: {{count}} accounts
quota.compatibility_note: Compatibility Basic/Premium metrics; bars show used / total. These are separate from rolling and monthly plan usage, with no confirmed conversion.
quota.premium_balance_unknown: Premium balance is unknown. It is not inferred from total minus used, and does not mean a zero balance.
quota.premium_balance_conflict: The reported Premium balance conflicts with total / used. The known value is retained pending verification.
quota.eligibility_conflict: Compatibility eligibility conflicts with plan-window data. Quotas have not been zeroed; verification is needed.
quota.rate_read_failed: The latest plan-usage read failed. Existing values are from the last recorded check, not a successful refresh.
